hypothesis: When a client aborts or disconnects prematurely during SSE streaming, the backend producer task might continue running and consuming LLM tokens indefinitely without listening to request cancellation.

If the background AI producer throws an unhandled exception (e.g. rate limit, JSON error, geocoding timeout), the queue may never receive a termination sentinel, causing the SSE generator to emit keep-alive pings forever.

If StreamingResponse lacks 'Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform' and 'X-Accel-Buffering: no', intermediate edge proxies or Cloudflare will buffer the tiny 20-byte heartbeat chunks, resulting in HTTP 524 timeout anyway.
A naive SSE reader that splits data purely per ReadableStream chunk will crash with JSON.parse errors when large itinerary payloads (10KB+) are fragmented across multiple TCP packets.
